name: movie_capella_isi_orbit
label: Movie: Capella's orbit with the ISI line at 900 nm, seven consecutive nights (the first intensity-interferometric binary orbit since Spica 1971)
notes: Baselines 5, 7 and 12 m: Capella's fringe period lambda/rho = 3.3 m at 900 nm is twice the 1.65 m pupils, so the pupil-averaged visibility (options.pupils) is the model; the 8.5 and 6.2 mas giants are resolved beyond ~25 m, so the line stays short.

Seven nights move the pair 24 deg around the 104 d orbit. Expected: 50-70 sigma fringes per night, sigma(a)/a ~0.2 % and sigma(node) ~0.1 deg with pupil smearing -- an independent check of Torres et al. 2015 (0.04 %), not an improvement.
